Class Multiblocks

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.multiblock.Multiblocks
public final class Multiblocks extends Object
Finding multiblocks in the world, and the formed ones (D33). Detection only reads blocks, through a blockAt function (MachineWorld.blockAt(BlockPosition) for a machine), so it runs on the thread that owns them; every block must be loaded and owned.
